svg.title: FigFox-Gen V3: actual evidence through one scientific-figure workflow
svg.desc: One bilingual workflow with actual Qwen-Music input, MusicGen and CosyVoice source SVG evidence, Transcormer palette source, Director record, validation result and generated Qwen figure. All images fit uniformly and are visually centered. No extra evidence panel.

text.font-family: Arial, PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, sans-serif
